candidateEvaluations.strategy: Instant Value Protection Strategy: Focuses on expiring points with an immediate risk-protection banner and a one-tap instant reward grid, respecting notification fatigue and suppression hints.
Quick-Win Carousel Strategy: Focuses on familiar quick-redeem items to minimize cognitive friction for a returning inactive user.

approvedCustomerStory.oneSentenceStory: The customer quickly secures tangible value for their 1,500 expiring points with a single tap, smoothly re-engaging after a period of inactivity.
approvedCustomerStory.customerSituation: Customer returns after 41 days of inactivity and discovers 1,500 points are set to expire within 7 days.
approvedCustomerStory.storyTension: Risk of losing accumulated value without feeling pressured or bombarded by intrusive alerts.
approvedCustomerStory.customerResolution: Customer browses a clean instant reward grid and redeems points for an immediate tangible voucher.
approvedCustomerStory.primaryOutcome: Immediate, satisfying claim of instant rewards using expiring points.

journeyCandidates.journeyObjective: Quickly discover and claim immediate tangible value for expiring points with minimal friction.
journeyCandidates.completionDefinition: Customer views expiring points notice and successfully redeems an instant reward item.
episodeSketches: User opens rewards overview and encounters clear points balance and expiring points risk banner.
User reviews instant reward grid tailored to past preferences.
User taps quick-redeem item and completes instant voucher claim.
